# Reference fixtures

`scores.json` contains independent analytic evaluations of the formula in
Switchyard `stage.rs` at commit
`7dddc65a099704a97cb1dd0f4858acc15ac2cda5`. Severity is rounded to IEEE float32 before
promotion, matching Rust `ToolSignals.severity`. Numerical tolerance is 1e-14.
These values were not generated by executing Rust.

Scenario origins include the upstream tests `one_signal_scores_below_half`,
`pick_tier_treats_the_exact_threshold_score_as_ambiguous`,
`new_activity_suppresses_stall_dimensions_without_biasing_the_score`,
`clean_production_resolves_to_efficient`,
`one_clean_write_among_many_reads_resolves_to_efficient`, and
`production_after_a_recent_error_stays_undecided`.

`turngate_test.go` additionally exercises the public normalized-history contract,
failed versus retrieved text, separate sliding windows, threshold edges, state
transitions, config copying, concurrent reads and malformed/bounded input.
